notes.title: Upcoming bug fixes!
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! Thanks as always for enjoying Re:Fresh. We wanted to get out a quick update regarding future patches and updates.

We're currently working on a new update to the game, included in which will be several bugfixes for issues currently found in the game. These fixes were originally meant to be released in a separate update, but we decided it would be smoothest to get them out with the new stuff (but we can't reveal what that new stuff is yet don't worry about it shhhhh)

We can't give any more specifics yet, but it won't be too long before we can and hope you look forward to it! Thanks again for your continued support.

- The Merge Conflict Team

notes.title: Quick patch revert
notes.notes:
Hi everyone! We've been made aware of some critical bugs present in the current patch of the game released earlier today and are temporarily reverting to the previous game version until these issues can be addressed.

We apologize for these bugs and any problems they might have caused with your playthrough of the game. For now, you should be able to play through the game fine with the current version we've reverted back to. Please let us know in the official bug forum if you encounter any new issues!

notes.title: Version 1.06
notes.notes:
Hey everyone! We have a patch out today to fix some nasty bugs that have been hanging around.

Changes

 Fixed an issue where some controllers couldn't initiate dialogue with non-critical NPCs
 Fixed an issue where the intro stinger for the Mushroom Woods area would repeatedly play when on the border of the area
 Adjusted some LOD/culling distances for a better visual experience and so that items could be seen from further away on low graphics settings
 Adjusted the collider on one tree object that was making it difficult to move under
 Fixed a single solar seedling in the town that was flying all over the place like a lil goober

notes.title: Version 1.05
notes.notes:
Gave a new animation to the player character on the title screen!
 Fixed a bug where you couldn't interact with the journal after loading in from a saved game
 Added a dialogue option for Leah that explains how to use the clothing store
 Fixed a bug where you didn't get the "Cell-ebrate" achievement if you first made progress on it on a save that you loaded into
 Made changes to help with performance on different graphics settings
 Added shadows to Low graphics settings while preserving performance
 Fixed a visual bug with clipping on the leaf bridges

notes.title: Version 1.04 - More bugfixes!
notes.notes:
Hey everyone, we've got another round of bug fixes and polish out right now!


 Fixed a bug where the cosmetics you previously bought wouldn't load back in from a saved game.
 Fixed a bug where if you loaded into a saved game where [spoiler]you had already completed Flint's quest and saved in the area where you previously couldn't recharge cells, you wouldn't be able to recharge there again after loading back into the game. [/spoiler]
 Fixed a bug where the background progress of repairing the Town outside of the main quests wouldn't load back in properly from a saved game.
 Fixed some bugged wind turbines in the Cliffs area.
 Fixed a detrimental instance of sequence breaking.
 Touched up collisions on some objects.
 Other various changes to polish.


Thanks again for your reports of bugs on our official forum! We hope you continue enjoying Re:Fresh :)

notes.title: Update 1.03
notes.notes:
Fixed the bug where camera sensitivity would be set extremely low by default on a new save, causing the camera to seem like it wasn't moving
 Fixed a bug where a set of stairs would be repaired too early in the progression of fixing the town
 Fixed collisions on some objects in the town where they weren't behaving correctly


Thanks so much to everyone who has given us the heads-up on bugs you have encountered! Please don't hesitate to use our official bug reporting forum on the Discussion page if you encounter anything. We're aware of other bugs that are still present and doing our best to get to them as soon as possible. Thank you for your understanding and we hope you keep enjoying Re:Fresh!

notes.title: Update 1.02
notes.notes: Fixed game locking during certain Petra dialogue

notes.title: Update 1.01
notes.notes: Fixed a bug that didn't allow players to quit the game :)

notes.title: Announcements on pricing and release plans for Re:Fresh!
notes.notes:
With the release of Re:Fresh coming up in just a few weeks (wishlist now!) we've got a few announcements and updates we want to share with everyone! 👇

1) Re:Fresh will launch at $4.99! We're excited to announce our price point, as well as a plan to get  Steam keys to fans.

2) Since we told some people that the game would release for free, we are opening up a Google form that will be available until our launch, where you can enter your info, and we'll send you a Steam key!

Fill out the form for your free Steam key here: ✨Link

3) In addition to our Steam key form, a condensed demo of the game will remain on Itch for free! (go download now: Link)

The full version of the game will also be available on Itch on launch, and will mimic the Steam price!🌱

4) All the pre-order t-shirts have been printed and will begin shipping soon! We've started delivering  some of the shirts by hand to our local friends, but out-of-town supporters will need to hang on just a  little longer. Thanks so much for your patience!!!

Lastly, we could not be more thankful for everyone's  support up to this point and are excited to deliver  the game to everyone on April 24th! ❤ 

If you have any questions about the game or how to get a Steam key, let us know!🍃
